# BCGov Crow - v0.19.0

## Release type

Minor release: a new Getting Started Agent and skill, preserving legacy
collection addresses and capabilities with a two-pass update.

## Summary

Adds focused, client-aware onboarding that helps developers select Crow
capabilities and write prompts for both localized and coordinated work.
Retires separately curated collections without removing their agents or
skills from the full package.

## Highlights

- Interviews developers about their outcome, client, stage, and constraints
  before recommending a starting route and copyable prompt.
- Supports coordinated re-platforming, security/remediation, and data-model
  tasks with bounded specialist assignments, dependencies, output ownership,
  approval checkpoints, and verification.
- Guides only: no automatic task execution, worker dispatch, installation,
  client changes, or deployment.
- Suggests the Raven Setup Agent when Raven capabilities are unavailable,
  while keeping local prompt guidance usable.
- Preserves the Starter Package and Security Remediation selectors
  as compatibility wrappers for the complete package. While either legacy
  selector remains, run the normal native APM update command twice: once to
  refresh wrapper metadata, then to resolve the full-root dependencies.
  Two-pass migration was validated with native APM 0.35.1 Git-fallback tests.
  Exact tags and archived installs remain pinned.
- Uninstalling the full package removes Crow content even when an alias is
  registered; the alias declaration must also be removed to prevent a later
  package operation from restoring Crow.

## Changes

- Added the Getting Started agent, skill, focused routing guidance, client
  recipes, and prompt templates.
- Replaced curated collection manifests with full-package compatibility
  dependencies and their associated validation contract.
- Updated installation discovery and Raven update recommendations to use the
  complete package while recognizing legacy selectors.

## Validation

- Native APM 0.35.1 two-pass migration passed for each legacy selector and
  both together, with exact full-content checks, stale dependency pruning,
  repeat updates, uninstall, and human-file preservation.
- Separate fresh-install and canonical-root coexistence/uninstall scenarios
  passed for each selector combination. Full-package uninstall removal is
  accepted behavior.
- The native baseline is the real v0.11.5 collection graph. Later collections
  contain standalone generic module/script dependencies unsupported by APM
  0.35.1; recovery of already-failed installations is not migration evidence
  and needs a separately approved canonical-root replacement.
- Candidate asset, package, compatibility, and review checks are required
  before publication; these notes do not attest to release execution.
- Archive inspection is required against the exact release commit.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.19.0 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.19.0.zip --global --target copilot
```
